On the other hand, Learned APP for the Respondent-State submits  that the Applicant and other co-accused defrauded the first informant to  the tune of Rs.22,00,000/-.
It is submitted that considering the nature of  crime, the Applicant may not be released on bail.
7. I have perused the FIR.
The main allegations are against the co-  accused.
The prosecution has already filed chargesheet against the  Applicant.
There are no other criminal antecedents against the Applicant.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances, I am inclined to release  the Applicant on anticipatory bail.

Hence, the following order:
 ORDER i.
The Anticipatory Bail Application is allowed.

ii. In the event of the arrest of the Applicant in Crime No.583 of 2024 registered with Charkop Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 506, 471, 468, 467, 465, 420 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, he shall be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
8. The Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.

(N.R. BORKAR, J.)
